svg.text: A Decimal Number is stored in binary, in 64 bits. Most numbers with decimals, like 3.14, cannot be stored exactly.
so it is cut off after 52 bits. Stored:
3 is exact, but .14 is not in base 2.
and grow when millions of rows are summed.
Two ways to store decimals in Power Query
Floating point, 64 bits: huge range, about 15
Fine for measurements, ratios and statistics.
Binary cannot store 3.14 exactly: use Fixed decimal when exact decimals matter.
